description_html:
Introduction

Enhance your projects with this dual-axis gear set, ideal for toys, robots, and small engines. This kit includes gears, screws, and shafts tailored for precise dual-axis mechanical movements, making it perfect for more complex DIY repairs and customizations.

Product Features

  • Dual-Axis Precision: Specifically designed for dual-axis applications, enabling complex and accurate mechanical movements in various projects.
  • Robust Construction: Features high-quality plastic gears and durable metal dowerl pin, ensuring long-lasting reliability and performance.
  • Flexible Gear Sizes: Includes a range of gear sizes and tooth counts for versatile gear ratio options, accommodating different mechanical needs.
  • Compact and Lightweight: Optimized for easy integration into compact spaces without adding significant weight.

Considerations

  • Ensure the gear sizes and shaft lengths align with your project requirements before purchase.
  • Designed for dual-axis systems; may not be compatible with single-axis applications.

description_text:
Enhance your projects with this dual-axis gear set, ideal for toys, robots, and small engines. This kit includes gears, screws, and shafts tailored for precise dual-axis mechanical movements, making it perfect for more complex DIY repairs and customizations.

Dual-Axis Precision: Specifically designed for dual-axis applications, enabling complex and accurate mechanical movements in various projects.

Robust Construction: Features high-quality plastic gears and durable metal dowerl pin, ensuring long-lasting reliability and performance.

Flexible Gear Sizes: Includes a range of gear sizes and tooth counts for versatile gear ratio options, accommodating different mechanical needs.

Compact and Lightweight: Optimized for easy integration into compact spaces without adding significant weight.

Ensure the gear sizes and shaft lengths align with your project requirements before purchase.

Designed for dual-axis systems; may not be compatible with single-axis applications.
